metadata.title: Roaring Lion Bursting Through Paper Illustration

retrievalProfile.description: A central roaring lion bursting through a torn paper surface with pink roses in the background and bold, blocky headline typography.
excludeWhen: modern flat vector illustration is needed
the subject is a domestic pet

recipe.visualDefinition: A highly detailed, airbrushed illustration of a male lion with an open mouth and extended claws, appearing to physically tear through a white paper background. Behind the tear, soft pink roses are visible, creating a contrast between the aggressive animal and delicate flora. The entire scene is framed by a solid green border with heavy, stylized typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Lion centered as the primary aggressive subject
Torn paper edges framing the lion's emergence
Pink roses providing a soft background contrast
Bold typography anchored to the top margin
Solid green border containing the entire composition
coreInvariants: The lion must be roaring with visible teeth and extended claws
The paper must appear physically torn with jagged, irregular edges
The color palette must include lime green, hot pink, and tawny browns

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The lion is centrally positioned, occupying approximately 60% of the frame, with paws extending toward the bottom foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lion's open mouth and eyes serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold top text down to the lion's face, then follows the paws outward toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white paper surface acts as the primary negative space, emphasizing the central tear.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background paper) and Tawny Brown (lion fur)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lime Green (border) and Hot Pink (roses and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border and text contrasts with the naturalistic, muted tones of the lion.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy block-like forms with minimal counters
Diagonal slices or 'cuts' through the middle of letters
Rounded outer corners on heavy stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is a solid thick ring
The 'A' has a very low crossbar
Letters feature a diagonal split effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant decorative face used for all text elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a roaring lion with extended claws bursting through a white paper surface. Behind the tear, include soft pink roses. Frame the entire image with a solid lime green border, leaving the top area clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, heavy block lettering in hot pink with a lime green outline at the top. The letters should have a diagonal slice through their centers.

verificationChecks: Is the lion's mouth open in a roar?
Are the claws extended toward the viewer?
Is the paper tear jagged and realistic?
Is the text heavy, pink, and outlined in green?

mustRedesign: Avoid using exact band names or logos
Ensure the lion illustration is original and not a direct copy

mustAchieve: Convincing 3D depth in the paper tear
avoid: Flat, unshaded colors in the lion
Clean, straight edges on the paper tear

postGenerationChecks: Verify the lion appears to be in front of the paper it is tearing
Check that the pink roses are visible through the tear
Ensure the green border is consistent on all four sides
Confirm the typography is legible despite the decorative slice
recipe.reuseFormula: Roaring [Subject] + Bursting Through [Material] + [Floral] Background + [Heavy Block] Typography + [Solid Color] Border
